flows.name: Recover a failed SharePoint delta item
steps: A SharePoint file download fails after Graph returns the delta batch
Record the failed item and preserve the prior delta cursor
Run the next scheduled Graph sync
flows.expectedOutcome: The failed delta batch is retried automatically, successful documents remain idempotent, and operations receive an internal warning with the exact failed-item count.

claims.description: Failed SharePoint file processing and folder-level exceptions retain the prior delta cursor.
The source-sync run ledger records failed files and scheduled recovery without exposing raw failures on client pages.
